column2:
railroad(n.)鐵路、鐵道
railway(n.)鐵路(英式)
railroad station 火車站
railroad track 鐵軌
The old railroad runs along the river.
(那條老鐵路沿著河流延伸。)
Do not walk on the railway tracks.
(不要在鐵軌上行走。)

raincoat(n.)雨衣
(無詞性變化)
wear a raincoat 穿雨衣
a yellow raincoat 黃色雨衣
Put on your raincoat before you go out.
(出門前先穿上雨衣。)
The little boy wore a yellow raincoat to school.
(那個小男孩穿著黃色雨衣上學。)

range(n./v.)範圍、山脈、(在範圍內)變動
(無詞性變化)
a wide range of 各式各樣的
mountain range 山脈
The shop sells a wide range of shoes.
(這家店賣各式各樣的鞋子。)
Prices range from 100 to 500 dollars.
(價格從一百元到五百元不等。)

rapid(adj.)快速的、迅速的
rapidly(adv.)快速地
rapid growth 快速成長
rapid change 快速的變化
The city has seen rapid growth.
(這座城市經歷了快速成長。)
The river flows rapidly after the rain.
(下雨後河水流得很快。)

rare(adj.)稀有的、罕見的、(肉)三分熟的
rarely(adv.)很少、難得
a rare chance 難得的機會
rare animals 稀有動物
Pandas are rare animals.
(貓熊是稀有動物。)
He rarely eats breakfast at home.
(他很少在家吃早餐。)

rat(n.)老鼠、大老鼠
(無詞性變化)
a big rat 一隻大老鼠
rat poison 老鼠藥
A big rat ran across the kitchen.
(一隻大老鼠跑過廚房。)
Rats like to live in dirty places.
(老鼠喜歡住在骯髒的地方。)

rather(adv.)相當、寧願、而不是
(無詞性變化)
would rather 寧願
rather than 而不是
I would rather stay home tonight.
(我今晚寧願待在家。)
The test was rather easy.
(這次考試相當簡單。)

reality(n.)現實、真實
real(adj.)真實的
realistic(adj.)實際的、寫實的
in reality 實際上
face reality 面對現實
Your dream can become a reality.
(你的夢想可以成真。)
In reality, he is very shy.
(實際上，他非常害羞。)

realize(v.)了解、意識到、實現
realization(n.)領悟、實現
realize a dream 實現夢想
suddenly realize 突然意識到
I didn't realize it was so late.
(我沒意識到已經這麼晚了。)
She worked hard to realize her dream.
(她努力實現自己的夢想。)

receive(v.)收到、接受
receiver(n.)接收者、聽筒
receipt(n.)收據
receive a letter 收到信
receive a gift 收到禮物
I received a letter from my aunt.
(我收到阿姨寄來的信。)
She received many gifts on her birthday.
(她生日時收到很多禮物。)

recent(adj.)最近的、近來的
recently(adv.)最近
in recent years 近幾年
recent news 最近的消息
Have you seen his recent photos?
(你看過他最近的照片嗎？)
I have been very busy recently.
(我最近很忙。)

record(n./v.)紀錄、唱片、記錄、錄製
recorder(n.)錄音機、直笛
recording(n.)錄音、錄影
break a record 打破紀錄
keep a record 做紀錄
He broke the school record.
(他打破了學校紀錄。)
She recorded the song on her phone.
(她用手機錄下了這首歌。)

recover(v.)恢復、康復、找回
recovery(n.)康復、恢復
recover from 從…中恢復
fully recover 完全康復
He recovered from a bad cold.
(他從重感冒中康復了。)
The police recovered the stolen bike.
(警方找回了被偷的腳踏車。)

refrigerator(n.)冰箱
fridge(n.)冰箱(口語)
in the fridge 在冰箱裡
fridge door 冰箱門
Put the milk in the refrigerator.
(把牛奶放進冰箱。)
There is some cake in the fridge.
(冰箱裡有一些蛋糕。)

refuse(v.)拒絕
refusal(n.)拒絕
refuse to 拒絕做…
refuse an offer 拒絕提議
He refused to answer the question.
(他拒絕回答這個問題。)
She refused my offer of help.
(她拒絕了我的幫忙。)

regard(n./v.)關心、尊重、將…視為
regarding(prep.)關於
regard A as B 把A視為B
best regards 敬祝安好(信末用語)
We regard him as our leader.
(我們把他視為我們的領袖。)
She has great regard for her teacher.
(她非常尊敬她的老師。)

region(n.)地區、區域
regional(adj.)地區的
mountain region 山區
a cold region 寒冷地區
This region is famous for tea.
(這個地區以茶聞名。)
Few people live in that cold region.
(很少人住在那個寒冷地區。)

regular(adj./n.)規律的、定期的、一般的、常客
regularly(adv.)規律地、定期地
regular exercise 規律運動
a regular customer 常客
Regular exercise keeps you healthy.
(規律運動讓你保持健康。)
He is a regular at this coffee shop.
(他是這家咖啡店的常客。)

reject(v.)拒絕、駁回
rejection(n.)拒絕
reject an idea 否決一個想法
reject a plan 否決計畫
The teacher rejected my idea.
(老師否決了我的想法。)
Her story was rejected by the magazine.
(她的故事被雜誌退稿了。)

relate(v.)使有關聯、敘述
related(adj.)有關的、有親屬關係的
relate to 與…有關、能理解
be related to 與…有關
This movie relates to real life.
(這部電影和真實生活有關。)
I can relate to how you feel.
(我能理解你的感受。)

relation(n.)關係、親戚
relative(n./adj.)親戚、相對的
in relation to 關於、與…相比
close relations 密切的關係
The two countries have good relations.
(這兩個國家關係良好。)
Is he a relation of yours?
(他是你的親戚嗎？)

relationship(n.)關係、人際關係
(無詞性變化)
a close relationship 親密的關係
build a relationship 建立關係
She has a good relationship with her parents.
(她和父母的關係很好。)
Trust is important in any relationship.
(信任在任何關係中都很重要。)

religion(n.)宗教
religious(adj.)宗教的、虔誠的
freedom of religion 宗教自由
world religions 世界各大宗教
People of many religions live here.
(許多不同宗教的人住在這裡。)
Religion is part of their culture.
(宗教是他們文化的一部分。)

remove(v.)移除、拿走、脫掉
removal(n.)移除
remove a stain 去除汙漬
remove your shoes 脫鞋
Please remove your shoes at the door.
(請在門口脫鞋。)
This soap can remove the stain.
(這種肥皂可以去除汙漬。)

rent(n./v.)租金、租用、出租
rental(n./adj.)租金、出租的
pay the rent 付房租
rent a car 租車
We rented a car for the trip.
(我們為這趟旅行租了一輛車。)
The rent here is very high.
(這裡的房租很高。)

repair(n./v.)修理、修補
(無詞性變化)
repair shop 修理店
under repair 修理中
My father repaired the broken chair.
(我爸爸修好了那張壞掉的椅子。)
The road is under repair now.
(這條路正在整修中。)

reply(n./v.)回答、回覆
(無詞性變化)
reply to 回覆…
in reply 作為回答
Please reply to my email soon.
(請盡快回覆我的電子郵件。)
I am still waiting for his reply.
(我還在等他的回覆。)

require(v.)需要、要求、requirement(n.)需求、必要條件
required(adj.)必需的、必修的
be required to 被要求做…
meet the requirements 符合要求
Students are required to wear uniforms.
(學生被要求穿制服。)
He meets all the job requirements.
(他符合所有的工作條件。)

respect(n./v.)尊敬、尊重、方面
respectful(adj.)恭敬的
respectable(adj.)值得尊敬的、體面的
show respect 表示尊敬
in many respects 在許多方面
We should respect our parents.
(我們應該尊敬父母。)
He has the respect of all his students.
(他受到所有學生的尊敬。)

respond(v.)回應、回答、反應
response(n.)回應、反應
respond to 回應…
respond quickly 迅速回應
She didn't respond to my message.
(她沒有回應我的訊息。)
The doctors responded quickly.
(醫生們迅速做出反應。)

responsible(adj.)負責的、應負責任的
responsibility(n.)責任
be responsible for 對…負責
a responsible person 負責任的人
I am responsible for cleaning the room.
(我負責打掃房間。)
He is a very responsible student.
(他是個很負責的學生。)

restroom(n.)廁所、洗手間
(無詞性變化)
public restroom 公共廁所
go to the restroom 上廁所
Excuse me, where is the restroom?
(不好意思，請問洗手間在哪裡？)
The restroom is on the second floor.
(洗手間在二樓。)

result(n./v.)結果、成績、導致、起因於
(無詞性變化)
as a result 結果、因此
result in 導致
I was happy with my test results.
(我對我的考試成績很滿意。)
Too much rain resulted in floods.
(雨量過多導致了水災。)

return(v./n.)回來、歸還、返回
(無詞性變化)
return home 回家
in return 作為回報
Please return the book by Friday.
(請在星期五前還書。)
He returned home late last night.
(他昨晚很晚才回家。)

review(n./v.)複習、評論、檢討
reviewer(n.)評論者
review a lesson 複習課程
book review 書評
I need to review for the test.
(我需要為考試複習。)
The movie got good reviews.
(這部電影得到好評。)

riches(n.)財富、財產
rich(adj.)有錢的、豐富的
great riches 鉅額財富
from rags to riches 從貧窮到致富
Riches cannot buy happiness.
(財富買不到快樂。)
The king had great riches.
(那位國王擁有龐大的財富。)

rocky(adj.)多岩石的、坎坷的
rock(n.)岩石
a rocky beach 岩石海灘
a rocky road 崎嶇的道路
We walked along the rocky beach.
(我們沿著多岩石的海灘散步。)
The path up the hill is rocky.
(上山的小路多岩石。)

role(n.)角色、作用
(無詞性變化)
play a role 扮演角色、發揮作用
role model 模範、榜樣
She played the main role in the play.
(她在這齣戲裡演主角。)
My mother is my role model.
(我媽媽是我的榜樣。)

roof(n./v.)屋頂、給…蓋屋頂
(無詞性變化)
on the roof 在屋頂上
a red roof 紅色屋頂
A cat is sleeping on the roof.
(一隻貓在屋頂上睡覺。)
The house has a red roof.
(那棟房子有紅色的屋頂。)

rooster(n.)公雞
(無詞性變化)
a rooster crows 公雞啼叫
Year of the Rooster 雞年
The rooster crows every morning.
(那隻公雞每天早上都會啼叫。)
My grandpa keeps a rooster on his farm.
(我爺爺在農場養了一隻公雞。)

royal(adj.)皇家的、王室的
royalty(n.)王室成員、版稅
royal family 皇室
royal palace 王宮
The royal family lives in that palace.
(皇室住在那座宮殿裡。)
We visited a royal palace in London.
(我們參觀了倫敦的一座王宮。)

rub(v./n.)摩擦、揉、擦
(無詞性變化)
rub your eyes 揉眼睛
rub your hands 搓手
Don't rub your eyes with dirty hands.
(不要用髒手揉眼睛。)
He rubbed his hands to keep warm.
(他搓手取暖。)

rubber(n.)橡膠、橡皮擦(英式)
(無詞性變化)
rubber band 橡皮筋
rubber boots 雨鞋
These boots are made of rubber.
(這雙靴子是用橡膠做的。)
Can I borrow a rubber band?
(可以借我一條橡皮筋嗎？)

rude(adj.)無禮的、粗魯的
rudely(adv.)無禮地
rudeness(n.)無禮
be rude to 對…無禮
a rude remark 無禮的話
It is rude to talk with food in your mouth.
(嘴裡有食物時說話很沒禮貌。)
Don't be rude to your teacher.
(不要對老師沒禮貌。)

runner(n.)跑者
run(v.)跑
a fast runner 跑得快的人
marathon runner 馬拉松跑者
She is the fastest runner in our class.
(她是我們班跑得最快的人。)
Thousands of runners joined the race.
(數千名跑者參加了這場賽跑。)
